rules: Materialization requires a complete normalized human review with readyForDryMasterSelection=true.
Normalized review bindings must still match the current 27-take session, technical receipt, provenance, queue and localization.
Every selected filename and SHA-256 must match one technically accepted take for the same cue.
Selected dry files are byte-for-byte copies. This tool performs no trim, denoise, EQ, gain, resample, compression or radio processing.
Materialization does not promote derived-master-approved, Unity-integrated, Quest-approved or release-approved status.
Any later edit creates a new file identity and requires documented processing plus another listening review.
runtimeBoundary: Claude owns radio EQ/static/dropouts, spatialization, ducking, runtime binding, subtitle timing and Quest intelligibility QA.
